d:
The Supreme Court on Tuesday observed that the protesters cannot occupy the protest site at all times, pointing out that other groups, including farmers, trade unions and workers, may also want to use the site.
'You cannot occupy a site for all time to come. There are other protesters. Where will the farmers go? Where will the workers go? Where will the trade unions go? Where will the homeless go? Everybody has a right to protest,' CJI Surya Kant said. Watch the video to know more.
Video Editor: Mann
